Grain Policies & Delivery Information
UWGP is committed to maintaining clear grain receiving standards and consistent quality expectations to help support efficient operations and dependable service for producers.
Please review the current grain discount schedule and delivery information prior to delivery. Discount schedules are subject to change based on market conditions, grain quality, and operational needs.

Questions About Grain Discounts or Delivery?
If you have questions regarding grain quality, discount schedules, or delivery information, please contact the UWGP grain team.
Contact Grain Team
United Wisconsin Grain Producers (UWGP) is a farmer-owned ethanol production facility in Friesland, Wisconsin, focused on producing renewable fuel and high-quality co-products. By supporting local corn markets and delivering ethanol, distillers grains (DDGS), and yeast products, UWGP plays a key role in advancing sustainable agriculture and energy solutions across the Midwest.
